claim: For gh0stl0nely/business-assets (public) a read-only GitHub API call on 2026-10-07 shows secret_scanning, secret_scanning_push_protection, secret_scanning_non_provider_patterns and secret_scanning_validity_checks all 'disabled'. GitHub's About secret scanning page says scanning 'runs automatically for free' on public repositories, but that partner secrets 'are reported directly to the provider and aren't displayed in your repository alerts'. So automatic scanning does not mean the owner is told about a leak; repository alerts and push protection are off until an admin enables them. Enabling (docs): Settings, then Security and quality, Advanced Security; to the right of Secret Protection click Enable and confirm; then, in the Secret Protection section, to the right of Push protection, click Enable. Push protection needs the repository owner or an admin role. This supersedes the 'runs on its own' reading of K-sec-0003 for this repository.
